set.body: Introduce a shared finite indexed-space foundation beneath image, surface, atlas, graph, spatial, dataset, MVPA, connectivity, threshold, and latent consumers. Reuse or migrate existing ordered axes, region, selection, label-map, searchlight, field, and parcel abstractions instead of creating parallel public models. The authoritative plan will live at docs/plans/finite-indexed-spaces.md. Completion requires explicit compatibility and retirement decisions, exhaustive and property law suites, and JVM plus Scala.js verification.
set.title: EPIC: one finite indexed-space calculus for regions, parcellations, and searchlights
